extra: sumatoria lista = sumatoria (tail lista) + head lista

solution:
sumatoria :: Num a => [a] -> a
sumatoria [] = 0
sumatoria (x:xs) = x + sumatoria xs
test:
it "sumatoria [] == 0" $ do
   sumatoria [] `shouldBe` 0

it "sumatoria [1, 2, 3] == 6" $ do
   sumatoria [1, 2, 3] `shouldBe` 6
   
it "sumatoria [5, 5] == 10" $ do
   sumatoria [5, 5] `shouldBe` 10

it "longitud [1, 2, 3, 4] == 4" $ do 
   longitud [1, 2, 3, 4] `shouldBe` 4
   
it "longitud [1, 2, 3] == 3" $ do 
   longitud [1, 2, 3] `shouldBe` 3
   
it "longitud [True, False] == 2" $ do 
   longitud [True, False] `shouldBe` 2

it "longitud [] == 0" $ do 
   longitud [] `shouldBe` 0
